page_note: This page is heavily substratic. After a brief frame in segs 3-8 where Mani receives the disciples' question and announces he will reveal the mystery of the five sayings, the page launches into a systematic five-fold cosmological mapping of the First Man's departure to combat: First Peace (from gods/angels of Land of Light), First Right-Hand (from Mother of Life), First Embrace (Mother of Life + all gods/angels of Aeons of Light), First Obeisance (First Man bending knees to God of Truth). The structure is clean substrate enumeration. Editorial fatigue score is strongly negative — frame vocabulary is concentrated in the first half (the question/answer setup) and dissipates as the cosmic teaching proceeds. Damage is significant in the lower half but does not interrupt the substrate structure.
